description: Evals for accessibility-review — verifies triggering accuracy and functional behavior across review modes and platforms

evals.description: Direct trigger using the canonical command phrase

evals.prompt: Run an a11y check on the dashboard spec
WCAG review on the checkout flow design
Check VoiceOver support for the notification settings feature
We need RGAA compliance — review the spec
Check GDPR compliance of the user profile feature
Design the feature from the spec
Accessibility review on the checkout flow brief at docs/features/checkout-flow/BRIEF.md
evals.description: Given a BRIEF mentioning React web forms, does the agent detect web platform and run triage?
expected_behavior: Detects BRIEF artifact type and enters Triage mode
Detects web platform from React mention
Flags form accessibility, keyboard nav, error handling

evals.prompt: Check accessibility of the notification settings design at docs/features/notification-settings/DESIGN.md. It's a React Native app.
evals.description: Given a DESIGN for a React Native feature, does the agent detect cross-platform and audit both iOS/Android?
expected_behavior: Detects DESIGN artifact type and enters Deep mode

evals.prompt: WCAG review on the dashboard spec — we need RGAA compliance too
evals.description: Given a web SPEC with RGAA requirement, does the agent include both WCAG and RGAA mappings?
expected_behavior: Both WCAG and RGAA references appear in findings table

evals.prompt: Check accessibility compliance of the notification system plan
evals.description: Given a PLAN and prior ACCESSIBILITY-REVIEW.md, does the agent run verify mode with testing coverage?
expected_behavior: Detects PLAN artifact type and enters Verify mode
Checks testing coverage (automated, manual, screen reader)

evals.prompt: Vérifie l'accessibilité du design de la page d'accueil
evals.description: If the conversation is in French, is the review still written in English?
expected_behavior: Section headers, findings, recommendations — all in English
